description: Radxa ZERO 3W (Rockchip RK3566) module-size board with eMMC, the user's RK3566 module family. A board record: Atlas flashes it from maskrom (rockusb) with Rockchip's loader file and no vendor tool; running, it serves the identity contract (board-lite, gaia/device.toml), read-only. Written from Radxa's docs and rkdeveloptool; untested on this board.

storage_target_evidence: docs.radxa.com ZERO 3 'Install OS on eMMC': the ZERO 3W is the variant with eMMC (the ZERO 3E has none and boots from microSD).
No SPI flash is named for the ZERO 3W, so the image (its own idblock at sector 64) goes to the eMMC from sector 0.
instructions: Take out the microSD card and unplug the power.
Hold the Maskrom button on the back of the board.
Connect the board's USB-C OTG port (USB 2.0, the one that also powers it) to this computer with a USB-A to USB-C cable, then release the button.
The power LED stays solid green in maskrom (RK3566). Atlas runs the loader's DDR init and usbplug, writes the image to the eMMC, reads it back and restarts the board.
todo: Sources: the maskrom steps, the OTG port and the green LED are from docs.radxa.com/en/zero/zero3/low-level-dev/install-os-on-emmc (fetched 2026-11-02). The PID 2207:350a is in rkdeveloptool 304f073's 99-rk-rockusb.rules:18 (RK3566), a vendor source; lsusb on the board still has the last word.

2207:350a is shared by RK3566 and RK3568: any RK356x board in maskrom is offered as the ZERO 3W, and its loader reports the same chip family. Confirm with lsusb on the board, and add a second RK356x record only with a way to tell them apart.

The loader: rkbin f43a462's RKBOOT/RK3566MINIALL.ini names rk3566_ddr_1056MHz_v1.23, rk356x_usbplug_v1.17 and rk356x_spl_v1.14 and builds rk356x_spl_loader_v1.23.114.bin. Those three parts are in fetch.lock (not in git). rkbin does not publish the merged loader: it needs rkbin's boot_merger, which Gaia runs in its build, so Atlas takes the merged file from Gaia's ZERO 3W build (not built yet, so no loader is on hand).

The Gaia facts (not verified on this side): sdcard.img is GPT with u-boot-rockchip.bin at 32 KiB (LBA 64), uboot-env at 16 MiB, then rootfs-a (extlinux), rootfs-b and data; mainline U-Boot 2026.01 and Linux 6.19; the gadget is usb0 at 10.55.0.1, the host gets 10.55.0.2.
Which button side and LED wording the 3W's own page uses beyond the shared ZERO 3 guide; the eMMC sizes offered (not on the page read).
Network: no Ethernet, Wi-Fi only; board-lite answers once a Gaia image sets Wi-Fi up (as the K230D).
